source.text: וַתְּהִ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ אֲרֻכָּ֔ה בֵּ֚ין בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וּבֵ֖ין בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וְדָוִד֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ וְחָזֵ֔ק וּבֵ֥ית שָׁא֖וּל הֹלְכִ֥ים וְדַלִּֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And was the war long between [the] house of Saul and between [the] house of David; and David [was] going and strong, and [the] house of Saul [were] going and weak.

en.L: And the war between the house of Saul and the house of David was long. And David went on growing strong, and the house of Saul went on growing weak.
en.B: The war between Saul's house and David's house dragged on for a long time. David grew steadily stronger, while the house of Saul grew steadily weaker.
en.R: The war between Saul's family and David's family lasted a long time. David's side kept getting stronger, and Saul's side kept getting weaker.

es.L: Y fue larga la guerra entre la casa de Saúl y la casa de David. Y David iba fortaleciéndose, y la casa de Saúl iba debilitándose.
es.B: La guerra entre la casa de Saúl y la casa de David se prolongó mucho tiempo. David se hacía cada vez más fuerte, mientras que la casa de Saúl se debilitaba cada vez más.
es.R: La guerra entre la familia de Saúl y la familia de David duró mucho tiempo. El bando de David se hacía cada vez más fuerte, y el bando de Saúl cada vez más débil.

fr.L: Et la guerre fut longue entre la maison de Saül et la maison de David. Et David allait en se fortifiant, et la maison de Saül allait en s’affaiblissant.
fr.B: La guerre entre la maison de Saül et la maison de David se prolongea longtemps. David devenait de plus en plus fort, tandis que la maison de Saül s’affaiblissait de plus en plus.
fr.R: La guerre entre la famille de Saül et la famille de David a duré longtemps. Le camp de David devenait de plus en plus fort, et le camp de Saül de plus en plus faible.

sw.L: Vita kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi vikawa vya muda mrefu. Naye Daudi akazidi kuwa na nguvu, na nyumba ya Sauli ikazidi kuwa dhaifu.
sw.B: Vita kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi viliendelea kwa muda mrefu. Daudi alizidi kupata nguvu, na nyumba ya Sauli ikazidi kudhoofika.
sw.R: Vita kati ya jamaa ya Sauli na jamaa ya Daudi vilidumu muda mrefu. Upande wa Daudi uliendelea kupata nguvu zaidi, na upande wa Sauli ukaendelea kudhoofika.

vi.L: Cuộc chiến giữa nhà Sau-lơ và nhà Đa-vít kéo dài. Đa-vít càng ngày càng mạnh, còn nhà Sau-lơ càng ngày càng yếu.
vi.B: Cuộc chiến giữa nhà Sau-lơ và nhà Đa-vít kéo dài rất lâu. Đa-vít ngày càng mạnh thêm, còn nhà Sau-lơ ngày càng suy yếu.
vi.R: Cuộc chiến giữa gia đình Sau-lơ và gia đình Đa-vít kéo dài rất lâu. Phe Đa-vít ngày càng mạnh, còn phe Sau-lơ ngày càng yếu đi.

ko.L: 그리고 사울의 집과 다윗의 집 사이에 전쟁이 오래 계속되었다. 그리고 다윗은 점점 강해졌고, 사울의 집은 점점 약해졌다.
ko.B: 사울 집안과 다윗 집안 사이의 전쟁은 오랫동안 이어졌다. 다윗은 갈수록 강해졌고, 사울 집안은 갈수록 약해졌다.
ko.R: 사울 집안과 다윗 집안 사이의 전쟁은 오래 계속되었다. 다윗 쪽은 점점 더 강해졌고, 사울 쪽은 점점 더 약해졌다.

pt.L: E a guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi foi longa. E Davi ia se fortalecendo, e a casa de Saul ia se enfraquecendo.
pt.B: A guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi se prolongou por muito tempo. Davi ficava cada vez mais forte, enquanto a casa de Saul ficava cada vez mais fraca.
pt.R: A guerra entre a família de Saul e a família de Davi durou muito tempo. O lado de Davi ficava cada vez mais forte, e o lado de Saul ficava cada vez mais fraco.

decisions.choice: the house of Saul, the house of David: each man's family and the people who supported his claim to rule
decisions.reason: "House" here means a royal family together with its followers. On one side stood Saul's son Ish-bosheth, made king by Abner (2:8-10); on the other stood David, king in Hebron over Judah (2:4).

decisions.choice: going and strong, going and weak: growing steadily stronger and steadily weaker
decisions.reason: The verb "go" joined to another word describes something that keeps on happening and increasing (Genesis 26:13; 1 Samuel 14:19). The verse sums up the years of war after 2:11 before Abner changes sides.

decisions.choice: Saul's family, David's family; David's side, Saul's side
decisions.reason: Readable says "family" and "side" so that "house" is not taken to mean a building.

decisions.choice: la famille, le camp (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "family" and "side": "maison" for a royal house is clear at Literal and Balanced, but at Readable it could be taken for a building.

source.text: וַיִּוָּלְד֧וּלְדָוִ֛ד בָּנִ֖ים בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיְהִ֤י בְכוֹרוֹ֙ אַמְנ֔וֹן לַאֲחִינֹ֖עַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And were born to David sons in Hebron; and was his firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelite.

en.L: And sons were born to David in Hebron. And his firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelite.
en.B: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam of Jezreel.
en.R: While David was in Hebron, sons were born to him. The oldest was Amnon, and his mother was Ahinoam from the town of Jezreel.

es.L: Y le nacieron hijos a David en Hebrón. Y su primogénito fue Amnón, de Ahinoam la jezreelita.
es.B: A David le nacieron hijos en Hebrón. Su primogénito fue Amnón, cuya madre era Ahinoam de Jezreel.
es.R: Mientras David estaba en Hebrón, le nacieron hijos. El mayor fue Amnón, y su madre era Ahinoam, del pueblo de Jezreel.

fr.L: Et il naquit à David des fils à Hébron. Et son premier-né fut Amnon, d’Ahinoam la Jizreélite.
fr.B: Il naquit des fils à David à Hébron. Son premier-né fut Amnon, dont la mère était Ahinoam de Jizreël.
fr.R: Pendant que David était à Hébron, des fils lui sont nés. L’aîné était Amnon, et sa mère était Ahinoam, de la ville de Jizreël.

sw.L: Wana wakazaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni. Mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni, kwa Ahinoamu Myezreeli.
sw.B: Daudi alizaliwa wana huko Hebroni. Mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli.
sw.R: Daudi alipokuwa Hebroni, alizaliwa wana. Wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni, na mama yake alikuwa Ahinoamu wa mji wa Yezreeli.

vi.L: Tại Hếp-rôn, Đa-vít sinh được các con trai. Con trưởng nam của ông là Am-nôn, do A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên [sinh ra].
vi.B: Tại Hếp-rôn, Đa-vít có các con trai. Con trưởng nam là Am-nôn, mẹ là A-hi-nô-am người Gít-rê-ên.
vi.R: Khi Đa-vít ở Hếp-rôn, ông có được các con trai. Con trai lớn nhất là Am-nôn, mẹ là A-hi-nô-am, quê ở thị trấn Gít-rê-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 헤브론에서 다윗에게 아들들이 태어났다. 그리고 그의 맏아들은 이스르엘 여자 아히노암에게서 [난] 암논이었다.
ko.B: 헤브론에서 다윗에게 아들들이 태어났다. 맏아들은 암논인데, 그의 어머니는 이스르엘 출신 아히노암이었다.
ko.R: 다윗이 헤브론에 있을 때 그에게 아들들이 태어났다. 맏아들은 암논이었고, 그의 어머니는 이스르엘 마을에서 온 아히노암이었다.

pt.L: E nasceram filhos a Davi em Hebrom. E o seu primogênito foi Amnom, de Ainoã, a jezreelita.
pt.B: Nasceram filhos a Davi em Hebrom. O seu primogênito foi Amnom, cuja mãe era Ainoã de Jezreel.
pt.R: Enquanto Davi estava em Hebrom, nasceram filhos a ele. O mais velho era Amnom, e a mãe dele era Ainoã, da cidade de Jezreel.

decisions.choice: were born: the reading noted in the margin
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text give a slightly different form of the verb from the one the scribes noted in the margin. Both mean that sons were born, and the meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: a list of the sons born at Hebron
decisions.reason: Verses 2-5 break into the story of the war to list David's six sons born during his seven and a half years in Hebron (2:11). 1 Chronicles 3:1-4 gives the same list. Several of these sons matter later: Amnon (chapter 13), Absalom (chapters 13-18) and Adonijah (1 Kings 1).

decisions.choice: Ahinoam the Jezreelite: from the Jezreel in Judah
decisions.reason: David married Ahinoam while he was on the run from Saul (1 Samuel 25:43). Her town is most likely the Jezreel in the hill country of Judah (Joshua 15:56), not the better-known Jezreel in the north.

decisions.choice: whose mother was (Balanced); his mother was (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "of Ahinoam" or "by Ahinoam". Balanced and Readable say plainly that she was the boy's mother, and the list keeps the same wording for each son.

decisions.choice: "Am-nôn", "Kin-ê-áp", "Áp-sa-lôm", "A-đô-ni-gia", "Sê-pha-tia", "Dít-rê-am"
decisions.reason: The sons' names: Amnon and Absalom as the Samuel terms note; the others take the usual Protestant forms and are kept through the book.

decisions.choice: Amnom; Quileabe, Absalão, Maaca, Talmai, Gesur (verse 3); Adonias, Hagite, Sefatias, Abital (verse 4); Itreão, Eglá (verse 5)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: David's sons and their mothers (m2) take their usual Brazilian forms, with the final "-m" Portuguese writes for a nasal ending ("Amnom", as "Hebrom") and the final "-e" it adds after a consonant ("Quileabe", "Hagite"); "Absalão" and "Adonias" are the forms Brazilian readers know. "Ainoã de Jezreel" and "Abigail" as 1 Samuel 27:3 in Portuguese; "Talmai" and "Gesur" as Joshua 13:13 and 15:14. The list keeps the same wording for each son, as the English does.

source.text: וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ כִלְאָ֔ב לַאֲֽבִיגַ֕יִלאֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֣ל הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֑י וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ גְּשֽׁוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: And his second Chileab, of Abigail [the] wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third Absalom son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur.

en.L: And his second [was] Chileab, by Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur.
en.B: His second was Chileab, whose mother was Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel. The third was Absalom, whose mother was Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur.
en.R: His second son was Chileab, and his mother was Abigail, who had been the wife of Nabal from Carmel. The third son was Absalom, and his mother was Maacah. She was the daughter of Talmai, the king of Geshur.

es.L: Y su segundo [fue] Quileab, de Abigail, la mujer de Nabal el carmelita; y el tercero, Absalón hijo de Maaca, hija de Talmai rey de Gesur.
es.B: Su segundo hijo fue Quileab, cuya madre era Abigail, la viuda de Nabal de Carmel. El tercero fue Absalón, cuya madre era Maaca, hija de Talmai, rey de Gesur.
es.R: Su segundo hijo fue Quileab, y su madre era Abigail, que había sido esposa de Nabal, de Carmel. El tercer hijo fue Absalón, y su madre era Maaca. Ella era hija de Talmai, el rey de Gesur.

fr.L: Et son second [fut] Kiléab, d’Abigaïl la femme de Nabal le Carmélite ; et le troisième, Absalom fils de Maaka, fille de Talmaï roi de Gueshour.
fr.B: Le deuxième fut Kiléab, dont la mère était Abigaïl, la veuve de Nabal de Carmel. Le troisième fut Absalom, dont la mère était Maaka, fille de Talmaï, roi de Gueshour.
fr.R: Son deuxième fils était Kiléab, et sa mère était Abigaïl, qui avait été la femme de Nabal de Carmel. Le troisième fils était Absalom, et sa mère était Maaka. Elle était la fille de Talmaï, le roi de Gueshour.

sw.L: Wa pili wake [alikuwa] Kileabu, kwa Abigaili mke wa Nabali Mkarmeli; na wa tatu, Absalomu mwana wa Maaka binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri.
sw.B: Wa pili alikuwa Kileabu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abigaili, mjane wa Nabali wa Karmeli. Wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Maaka binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri.
sw.R: Mwana wa pili alikuwa Kileabu, na mama yake alikuwa Abigaili, aliyekuwa mke wa Nabali wa Karmeli. Mwana wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, na mama yake alikuwa Maaka. Yeye alikuwa binti wa Talmai, mfalme wa Geshuri.

vi.L: Con thứ hai là Kin-ê-áp, do A-bi-ga-in vợ của Na-banh người Cạt-mên [sinh ra]; con thứ ba là Áp-sa-lôm, con trai của Ma-a-ca, con gái Thanh-mai vua Ghê-su-rơ.
vi.B: Con thứ hai là Kin-ê-áp, mẹ là A-bi-ga-in, vợ góa của Na-banh người Cạt-mên. Con thứ ba là Áp-sa-lôm, mẹ là Ma-a-ca, con gái Thanh-mai vua Ghê-su-rơ.
vi.R: Con trai thứ hai là Kin-ê-áp, mẹ là A-bi-ga-in, trước kia là vợ của Na-banh người Cạt-mên. Con trai thứ ba là Áp-sa-lôm, mẹ là Ma-a-ca. Bà là con gái của Thanh-mai, vua xứ Ghê-su-rơ.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 둘째는 갈멜 사람 나발의 아내 아비가일에게서 [난] 길르압이고, 셋째는 그술 왕 달매의 딸 마아가의 아들 압살롬이었다.
ko.B: 둘째는 길르압인데, 그의 어머니는 갈멜 사람 나발의 아내였던 아비가일이었다. 셋째는 압살롬인데, 그의 어머니는 그술 왕 달매의 딸 마아가였다.
ko.R: 둘째 아들은 길르압이었고, 그의 어머니는 갈멜 사람 나발의 아내였던 아비가일이었다. 셋째 아들은 압살롬이었고, 그의 어머니는 마아가였다. 마아가는 그술 왕 달매의 딸이었다.

pt.L: E o seu segundo [foi] Quileabe, de Abigail, mulher de Nabal, o carmelita; e o terceiro, Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur.
pt.B: O segundo foi Quileabe, cuja mãe era Abigail, viúva de Nabal de Carmelo. O terceiro foi Absalão, cuja mãe era Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur.
pt.R: O segundo filho era Quileabe, e a mãe dele era Abigail, que tinha sido mulher de Nabal, de Carmelo. O terceiro filho era Absalão, e a mãe dele era Maaca. Ela era filha de Talmai, o rei de Gesur.

decisions.choice: Abigail: the reading noted in the margin
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell Abigail's name in a shorter form; the scribes' marginal reading gives the usual spelling, as in 1 Samuel 25. It is the same woman.

decisions.choice: Chileab: called Daniel in the parallel list
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 3:1 names David's second son "Daniel". He may have had two names. Nothing more is told of him.

decisions.choice: the wife of Nabal: Abigail had been Nabal's wife until his death
decisions.reason: Nabal died soon after Abigail met David, and David then married her (1 Samuel 25:37-42). The list still names her by her first husband.

decisions.choice: Talmai king of Geshur: a small kingdom northeast of Israel
decisions.reason: Geshur was a small Aramean kingdom east of the Sea of Galilee, which Israel had never driven out (Joshua 13:13). Marrying a king's daughter made an alliance. Absalom later fled to his grandfather Talmai (13:37-38).

decisions.choice: the widow of Nabal (Balanced); who had been the wife of Nabal (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "wife of Nabal". Since Nabal had died before she married David, Balanced says "widow" and Readable "had been the wife", so that readers do not think she was still married to him.

decisions.choice: "Quileab", "Absalón", "Maaca", "Talmai", "Gesur"
decisions.reason: Names in their usual Spanish forms, "Absalón" as the published Psalm 3 title; the same forms are kept through both books.

source.text: וְהָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֣ה בֶן־חַגִּ֑ית וְהַחֲמִישִׁ֖י שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן־אֲבִיטָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And the fourth Adonijah son of Haggith; and the fifth Shephatiah son of Abital.

en.L: And the fourth [was] Adonijah son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah son of Abital.
en.B: The fourth was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, and the fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital.
en.R: The fourth son was Adonijah, and his mother was Haggith. The fifth son was Shephatiah, and his mother was Abital.

es.L: Y el cuarto [fue] Adonías hijo de Haguit; y el quinto, Sefatías hijo de Abital.
es.B: El cuarto fue Adonías, cuya madre era Haguit, y el quinto fue Sefatías, cuya madre era Abital.
es.R: El cuarto hijo fue Adonías, y su madre era Haguit. El quinto hijo fue Sefatías, y su madre era Abital.

fr.L: Et le quatrième [fut] Adonias fils de Haggith ; et le cinquième, Shephatia fils d’Abital.
fr.B: Le quatrième fut Adonias, dont la mère était Haggith, et le cinquième Shephatia, dont la mère était Abital.
fr.R: Le quatrième fils était Adonias, et sa mère était Haggith. Le cinquième fils était Shephatia, et sa mère était Abital.

sw.L: Na wa nne [alikuwa] Adoniya mwana wa Hagithi; na wa tano, Shefatia mwana wa Abitali.
sw.B: Wa nne alikuwa Adoniya, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Hagithi, na wa tano alikuwa Shefatia, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abitali.
sw.R: Mwana wa nne alikuwa Adoniya, na mama yake alikuwa Hagithi. Mwana wa tano alikuwa Shefatia, na mama yake alikuwa Abitali.

vi.L: Con thứ tư là A-đô-ni-gia, con trai của Ha-ghít; con thứ năm là Sê-pha-tia, con trai của A-bi-tanh.
vi.B: Con thứ tư là A-đô-ni-gia, mẹ là Ha-ghít; con thứ năm là Sê-pha-tia, mẹ là A-bi-tanh.
vi.R: Con trai thứ tư là A-đô-ni-gia, mẹ là Ha-ghít. Con trai thứ năm là Sê-pha-tia, mẹ là A-bi-tanh.

ko.L: 그리고 넷째는 학깃의 아들 아도니야이고, 다섯째는 아비달의 아들 스바댜였다.
ko.B: 넷째는 아도니야인데 그의 어머니는 학깃이었고, 다섯째는 스바댜인데 그의 어머니는 아비달이었다.
ko.R: 넷째 아들은 아도니야였고, 그의 어머니는 학깃이었다. 다섯째 아들은 스바댜였고, 그의 어머니는 아비달이었다.

pt.L: E o quarto [foi] Adonias, filho de Hagite; e o quinto, Sefatias, filho de Abital.
pt.B: O quarto foi Adonias, cuja mãe era Hagite, e o quinto foi Sefatias, cuja mãe era Abital.
pt.R: O quarto filho era Adonias, e a mãe dele era Hagite. O quinto filho era Sefatias, e a mãe dele era Abital.

decisions.choice: son of Haggith, son of Abital: named by their mothers
decisions.reason: In a household with several wives, sons of the same father were told apart by their mothers. The list names each son's mother, as in verses 2-3.

decisions.choice: Adonijah: the son who later tried to take the throne
decisions.reason: When David was old, Adonijah, as the oldest living son, claimed the kingdom, and is still called "son of Haggith" there (1 Kings 1:5).

decisions.choice: whose mother was (Balanced); his mother was (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: Adonias
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the name, as in the French tradition for Solomon's rival in 1 Kings 1.

source.text: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁ֣י יִתְרְעָ֔ם לְעֶגְלָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת דָּוִ֑ד אֵ֛לֶּה יֻלְּד֥וּ לְדָוִ֖ד בְּחֶבְרֽוֹן׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And the sixth Ithream, of Eglah [the] wife of David. These were born to David in Hebron.

en.L: And the sixth [was] Ithream, by Eglah, David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
en.B: The sixth was Ithream, whose mother was Eglah, David's wife. These sons were born to David in Hebron.
en.R: The sixth son was Ithream, and his mother was Eglah, another of David's wives. These six sons were born to David while he was in Hebron.

es.L: Y el sexto [fue] Itream, de Egla, mujer de David. Estos le nacieron a David en Hebrón.
es.B: El sexto fue Itream, cuya madre era Egla, esposa de David. Estos hijos le nacieron a David en Hebrón.
es.R: El sexto hijo fue Itream, y su madre era Egla, otra de las esposas de David. Estos seis hijos le nacieron a David mientras estaba en Hebrón.

fr.L: Et le sixième [fut] Ithream, d’Égla, femme de David. Ceux-là naquirent à David à Hébron.
fr.B: Le sixième fut Ithream, dont la mère était Égla, femme de David. Tels sont les fils qui naquirent à David à Hébron.
fr.R: Le sixième fils était Ithream, et sa mère était Égla, une autre des femmes de David. Ces six fils sont nés à David pendant qu’il était à Hébron.

sw.L: Na wa sita [alikuwa] Ithreamu, kwa Egla mke wa Daudi. Hawa walizaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni.
sw.B: Wa sita alikuwa Ithreamu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Egla, mke wa Daudi. Wana hawa walizaliwa kwa Daudi huko Hebroni.
sw.R: Mwana wa sita alikuwa Ithreamu, na mama yake alikuwa Egla, mke mwingine wa Daudi. Wana hawa sita walizaliwa kwa Daudi alipokuwa Hebroni.

vi.L: Con thứ sáu là Dít-rê-am, do Éc-la vợ Đa-vít [sinh ra]. Những người này sinh cho Đa-vít tại Hếp-rôn.
vi.B: Con thứ sáu là Dít-rê-am, mẹ là Éc-la, vợ Đa-vít. Đó là các con trai Đa-vít sinh tại Hếp-rôn.
vi.R: Con trai thứ sáu là Dít-rê-am, mẹ là Éc-la, một người vợ khác của Đa-vít. Sáu người con trai này sinh ra khi Đa-vít còn ở Hếp-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 여섯째는 다윗의 아내 에글라에게서 [난] 이드르암이었다. 이들이 헤브론에서 다윗에게 태어났다.
ko.B: 여섯째는 이드르암인데, 그의 어머니는 다윗의 아내 에글라였다. 이 아들들이 헤브론에서 다윗에게 태어났다.
ko.R: 여섯째 아들은 이드르암이었고, 그의 어머니는 다윗의 또 다른 아내 에글라였다. 이 여섯 아들이 다윗이 헤브론에 있을 때 태어났다.

pt.L: E o sexto [foi] Itreão, de Eglá, mulher de Davi. Estes nasceram a Davi em Hebrom.
pt.B: O sexto foi Itreão, cuja mãe era Eglá, mulher de Davi. Esses filhos nasceram a Davi em Hebrom.
pt.R: O sexto filho era Itreão, e a mãe dele era Eglá, outra das mulheres de Davi. Esses seis filhos nasceram a Davi enquanto ele estava em Hebrom.

decisions.choice: Eglah, David's wife
decisions.reason: All six women were David's wives, but only Eglah is called "David's wife" here. The text does not say why; the words may simply round off the list. 1 Chronicles 3:3 says the same.

decisions.choice: these were born to David in Hebron: the end of the list
decisions.reason: The closing words repeat the opening of verse 2, marking where the list ends and the story of Abner takes up again.

decisions.choice: another of David's wives; these six sons
decisions.reason: Readable adds "another of" so that Eglah is not taken to be David's only wife, and gives the number of sons the list has named.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י בִּֽהְיוֹת֙ הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וּבֵ֖ין בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וְאַבְנֵ֛ר הָיָ֥ה מִתְחַזֵּ֖ק בְּבֵ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, while was the war between [the] house of Saul and between [the] house of David, and Abner was making himself strong in [the] house of Saul.

en.L: And it happened, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner was making himself strong in the house of Saul.
en.B: While the war went on between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner was steadily building up his own power in the house of Saul.
en.R: During the war between Saul's family and David's family, Abner was making himself more and more powerful among Saul's people.

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras había guerra entre la casa de Saúl y la casa de David, Abner se iba haciendo fuerte en la casa de Saúl.
es.B: Mientras duraba la guerra entre la casa de Saúl y la casa de David, Abner iba aumentando su propio poder en la casa de Saúl.
es.R: Durante la guerra entre la familia de Saúl y la familia de David, Abner se fue haciendo cada vez más poderoso entre la gente de Saúl.

fr.L: Et il arriva, pendant qu’il y avait la guerre entre la maison de Saül et la maison de David, qu’Abner se fortifiait dans la maison de Saül.
fr.B: Tandis que la guerre se poursuivait entre la maison de Saül et la maison de David, Abner renforçait peu à peu son propre pouvoir dans la maison de Saül.
fr.R: Pendant la guerre entre la famille de Saül et la famille de David, Abner devenait de plus en plus puissant parmi les partisans de Saül.

sw.L: Ikawa, vita vilipokuwa kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi, Abneri alikuwa akijiimarisha katika nyumba ya Sauli.
sw.B: Vita vilipoendelea kati ya nyumba ya Sauli na nyumba ya Daudi, Abneri alikuwa akijiongezea mamlaka yake mwenyewe katika nyumba ya Sauli.
sw.R: Wakati wa vita kati ya jamaa ya Sauli na jamaa ya Daudi, Abneri alikuwa akizidi kujipatia mamlaka zaidi na zaidi kati ya watu wa Sauli.

vi.L: Trong khi có chiến tranh giữa nhà Sau-lơ và nhà Đa-vít, thì Áp-ne làm cho mình mạnh thế trong nhà Sau-lơ.
vi.B: Trong lúc chiến tranh giữa nhà Sau-lơ và nhà Đa-vít còn tiếp diễn, Áp-ne cứ củng cố quyền lực của mình trong nhà Sau-lơ.
vi.R: Trong thời gian có chiến tranh giữa gia đình Sau-lơ và gia đình Đa-vít, Áp-ne ngày càng nắm nhiều quyền hành trong phe Sau-lơ.

ko.L: 그리고 사울의 집과 다윗의 집 사이에 전쟁이 있는 동안에, 아브넬이 사울의 집에서 자기 세력을 굳혀 갔다.
ko.B: 사울 집안과 다윗 집안 사이에 전쟁이 계속되는 동안, 아브넬은 사울 집안에서 자기 세력을 점점 키워 갔다.
ko.R: 사울 집안과 다윗 집안이 싸우는 동안, 아브넬은 사울 쪽 사람들 사이에서 점점 더 큰 힘을 가지게 되었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, enquanto havia guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi, Abner ia se fortalecendo na casa de Saul.
pt.B: Enquanto a guerra continuava entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi, Abner ia aumentando o seu próprio poder na casa de Saul.
pt.R: Durante a guerra entre a família de Saul e a família de Davi, Abner foi ficando cada vez mais poderoso entre o povo de Saul.

decisions.choice: while there was war: the story picks up again from verse 1
decisions.reason: After the list of sons, these words take up the war of verse 1 again and lead into what happened between Abner and Ish-bosheth.

decisions.choice: making himself strong: strengthening his own position
alternatives: holding firmly to the house of Saul
giving strong support to the house of Saul
decisions.reason: The form of the verb means "to make oneself strong". It can describe loyal effort on behalf of Saul's house, but here it most likely means that Abner was gathering power for himself within it, which is the background to Ish-bosheth's charge in verse 7.

decisions.choice: his own power (Balanced); more and more powerful (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that the strength Abner was building was his own; see the meaning decision on these words.

source.text: וּלְשָׁא֣וּל פִּלֶ֔גֶשׁ וּשְׁמָ֖הּ רִצְפָּ֣ה בַת־אַיָּ֑ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־אַבְנֵ֔ר מַדּ֥וּעַ בָּ֖אתָה אֶל־פִּילֶ֥גֶשׁ אָבִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Saul [was] a concubine, and her name [was] Rizpah daughter of Aiah; and he said to Abner, Why have you gone in to [the] concubine of my father?

en.L: Now Saul had a concubine, and her name [was] Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And he said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father's concubine?"
en.B: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. Ish-bosheth said to Abner, "Why have you slept with my father's concubine?"
en.R: Saul had had a concubine (a secondary wife) named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. Ish-bosheth said to Abner, "Why did you sleep with my father's concubine?"

es.L: Y Saúl tenía una concubina, y su nombre [era] Rizpa hija de Aja. Y dijo a Abner: «¿Por qué te has llegado a la concubina de mi padre?».
es.B: Saúl había tenido una concubina llamada Rizpa, hija de Aja. Isboset le dijo a Abner: «¿Por qué te acostaste con la concubina de mi padre?».
es.R: Saúl había tenido una concubina (una esposa de segundo rango) llamada Rizpa, hija de Aja. Isboset le dijo a Abner: «¿Por qué te acostaste con la concubina de mi padre?».

fr.L: Or Saül avait une concubine, et son nom [était] Ritspa fille d’Ayya. Et il dit à Abner : « Pourquoi es-tu entré vers la concubine de mon père ? »
fr.B: Or Saül avait eu une concubine nommée Ritspa, fille d’Ayya. Ishbosheth dit à Abner : « Pourquoi as-tu couché avec la concubine de mon père ? »
fr.R: Saül avait eu une concubine (une épouse de second rang) qui s’appelait Ritspa. C’était la fille d’Ayya. Ishbosheth a dit à Abner : « Pourquoi as-tu couché avec la concubine de mon père ? »

sw.L: Basi Sauli alikuwa na suria, na jina lake [lilikuwa] Rispa binti Aya. Akamwambia Abneri, "Kwa nini umeingia kwa suria wa baba yangu?"
sw.B: Basi Sauli alikuwa na suria aitwaye Rispa binti Aya. Ishboshethi akamwambia Abneri, "Kwa nini umelala na suria wa baba yangu?"
sw.R: Sauli alikuwa na suria (mke wa daraja la chini) aitwaye Rispa, binti Aya. Ishboshethi akamwambia Abneri, "Kwa nini ulilala na suria wa baba yangu?"

vi.L: Sau-lơ có một người vợ lẽ tên là Ríp-ba, con gái của Ai-gia. [Ích-bô-sết] nói với Áp-ne: "Sao ngươi đã đi vào với vợ lẽ của cha ta?"
vi.B: Sau-lơ có một người vợ lẽ tên là Ríp-ba, con gái của Ai-gia. Ích-bô-sết hỏi Áp-ne: "Sao ngươi lại ăn nằm với vợ lẽ của cha ta?"
vi.R: Sau-lơ có một người vợ lẽ, tức là vợ thứ, tên là Ríp-ba, con gái của Ai-gia. Ích-bô-sết hỏi Áp-ne: "Tại sao ngươi ngủ với vợ lẽ của cha ta?"

ko.L: 그런데 사울에게 첩이 있었는데, 그의 이름은 아야의 딸 리스바[였다]. 그리고 그가 아브넬에게 말했다. "너는 어찌하여 내 아버지의 첩과 동침하였느냐?"
ko.B: 사울에게는 아야의 딸 리스바라는 첩이 있었다. 이스보셋이 아브넬에게 말했다. "너는 왜 내 아버지의 첩과 잠자리를 같이했느냐?"
ko.R: 사울에게는 첩이 하나 있었다. 첩은 정식 아내보다 낮은 신분의 아내였다. 그 여자의 이름은 리스바이고, 아야의 딸이었다. 이스보셋이 아브넬에게 말했다. "왜 내 아버지의 첩과 함께 잤느냐?"

pt.L: E Saul tinha uma concubina, e o seu nome [era] Rispa, filha de Aiá. E ele disse a Abner: "Por que você se deitou com a concubina do meu pai?"
pt.B: Saul tinha tido uma concubina chamada Rispa, filha de Aiá. Is-Bosete disse a Abner: "Por que você dormiu com a concubina do meu pai?"
pt.R: Saul tinha tido uma concubina (uma esposa secundária) chamada Rispa, filha de Aiá. Is-Bosete disse a Abner: "Por que você dormiu com a concubina do meu pai?"

decisions.choice: concubine: a wife of lower rank
decisions.reason: A concubine was a wife with fewer rights than a full wife, often without a bride-price, and her children did not always inherit. Rizpah had two sons by Saul (21:8).

decisions.choice: taking a dead king's concubine: a claim to his throne
decisions.reason: A new king took over his predecessor's household, including his wives (12:8). For another man to take a dead king's concubine could be read as a claim to rule (16:21-22; 1 Kings 2:22). So Ish-bosheth's question is an accusation of disloyalty, not only of wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: and he said: the speaker is not named
decisions.reason: The traditional Hebrew text says only "and he said". Some ancient witnesses add the name Ish-bosheth, Saul's son, and the next verse makes clear that he is the speaker.

decisions.choice: gone in to: had sexual relations with
decisions.reason: "Go in to" a woman is a common way of speaking of sexual relations (Genesis 16:2; 29:23).

decisions.choice: Ish-bosheth said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker, as verse 8 does, so the reader is not left to guess.

decisions.choice: concubine (a secondary wife)
decisions.reason: As set for these books, Readable explains "concubine" the first time it appears in a chapter.

decisions.choice: suria; R adds "(mke wa daraja la chini)"
decisions.reason: "Suria" is the word used for a concubine in Genesis; Readable explains it as a wife of lower rank, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "[Ích-bô-sết]" (L); "Ích-bô-sết" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name the speaker (meaning decision); Vietnamese needs a subject, and Literal brackets the name the English Balanced and Readable supply.

decisions.choice: Ish-bosheth says "ta" and "ngươi" to Abner; Abner answers with "tôi" and "ông"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for a king; Abner, the older kinsman who made him king, answers in anger without any royal form, which the Vietnamese pronouns show.

decisions.choice: Ish-bosheth, as king, speaks to Abner in the plain style (해라체); Abner answers in the formal polite style (합쇼체), even in anger
alternatives: Abner answering in the plain style to show contempt
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note has the king speak 해라체 to subjects and subjects answer in 합쇼체; Abner's anger shows in his words, not in a change of speech level.

decisions.choice: concubina; uma esposa secundária (R); se deitou com (L), dormiu com (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Concubina" is the Portuguese word for a wife of lower rank (m1); Readable explains it once, as the English does, with "esposa secundária", the wording of Genesis 22:24 in Portuguese. Literal says "se deitou com" for "went in to" (m4), the plain Portuguese for sexual relations; Balanced and Readable say "dormiu com", as the English says "slept with". "Rispa" and "Aiá" are the usual Brazilian forms. The king says "você" to his commander.

source.text: וַיִּחַר֩ לְאַבְנֵ֨ר מְאֹ֜ד עַל־דִּבְרֵ֣י אִֽישׁ־בֹּ֗שֶׁת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הֲרֹ֨אשׁ כֶּ֥לֶב אָנֹ֘כִי֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽיהוּדָה֒ הַיּ֨וֹם אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־חֶ֜סֶד עִם־בֵּ֣ית׀שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֗יךָ אֶל־אֶחָיו֙ וְאֶל־מֵ֣רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְלֹ֥א הִמְצִיתִ֖ךָ בְּיַד־דָּוִ֑ד וַתִּפְקֹ֥ד עָלַ֛י עֲוֺ֥ן הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And burned to Abner exceedingly over [the] words of Ish-bosheth, and he said, [Am] I a dog's head which [belongs] to Judah? This day I show steadfast love to [the] house of Saul your father, to his brothers and to his friends, and I have not caused you to be found in [the] hand of David; and you charge on me [the] guilt of the woman today.

en.L: And Abner was very angry over the words of Ish-bosheth, and he said, "[Am] I a dog's head that [belongs] to Judah? This day I show steadfast love to the house of Saul your father, to his brothers and to his friends, and I have not let you fall into the hand of David; and you charge me today with guilt over the woman!
en.B: Abner was furious at Ish-bosheth's words. "Am I a dog's head on Judah's side?" he said. "To this day I have kept faithful love toward the house of your father Saul, toward his brothers and his friends, and I have not let you fall into David's hands. And now you charge me with wrongdoing over this woman!
en.R: Abner became very angry at what Ish-bosheth said. He answered, "Do you think I am a worthless dog who works for Judah? All this time I have shown faithful love to your father Saul's family, his relatives and his friends. I have not let David capture you. And now you accuse me of doing wrong with this woman!

es.L: Y se enojó Abner mucho por las palabras de Isboset, y dijo: «¿[Soy] yo cabeza de perro que [pertenece] a Judá? Hoy muestro amor leal a la casa de Saúl tu padre, a sus hermanos y a sus amigos, y no te he dejado caer en mano de David, ¡y tú me acusas hoy de culpa por esa mujer!
es.B: Abner se enfureció por las palabras de Isboset. «¿Acaso soy yo una cabeza de perro del lado de Judá?», dijo. «Hasta hoy he mantenido mi amor fiel hacia la casa de tu padre Saúl, hacia sus hermanos y sus amigos, y no te he dejado caer en manos de David. ¡Y ahora me acusas de una falta por esta mujer!
es.R: Abner se enojó mucho por lo que dijo Isboset. Le respondió: «¿Crees que soy un perro despreciable que trabaja para Judá? Todo este tiempo he mostrado amor fiel a la familia de tu padre Saúl, a sus parientes y a sus amigos. No he dejado que David te capture. ¡Y ahora me acusas de haber hecho algo malo con esta mujer!

fr.L: Et Abner fut très irrité des paroles d’Ishbosheth, et il dit : « [Suis]-je une tête de chien qui [appartient] à Juda ? Aujourd’hui je montre de l’amour loyal envers la maison de Saül ton père, envers ses frères et envers ses amis, et je ne t’ai pas fait tomber dans la main de David ; et tu me reproches aujourd’hui une faute au sujet de cette femme !
fr.B: Abner fut furieux des paroles d’Ishbosheth. « Suis-je une tête de chien au service de Juda ? dit-il. Jusqu’à ce jour, j’ai gardé un amour fidèle envers la maison de ton père Saül, envers ses frères et ses amis, et je ne t’ai pas livré aux mains de David. Et voilà que tu m’accuses d’une faute au sujet de cette femme !
fr.R: Abner s’est mis en grande colère à cause de ce qu’avait dit Ishbosheth. Il a répondu : « Est-ce que tu me prends pour un chien sans valeur qui travaille pour Juda ? Pendant tout ce temps, j’ai montré un amour fidèle à la famille de ton père Saül, à ses parents et à ses amis. Je n’ai pas laissé David te capturer. Et maintenant, tu m’accuses d’avoir mal agi avec cette femme !

sw.L: Abneri akakasirika sana kwa sababu ya maneno ya Ishboshethi, akasema, "Je, mimi [ni] kichwa cha mbwa kilicho cha Yuda? Leo hii ninaitendea nyumba ya Sauli baba yako upendo usiokoma, ndugu zake na rafiki zake, wala sikukutia mkononi mwa Daudi; nawe leo unanishtaki kwa hatia juu ya mwanamke huyu!
sw.B: Abneri alikasirika mno kwa maneno ya Ishboshethi. Akasema, "Je, mimi ni kichwa cha mbwa upande wa Yuda? Mpaka leo nimeitendea fadhili nyumba ya Sauli baba yako, ndugu zake na rafiki zake, wala sikukuacha uangukie mikononi mwa Daudi. Na sasa unanishtaki kwa kosa juu ya mwanamke huyu!
sw.R: Abneri alikasirika sana kwa maneno ya Ishboshethi. Akajibu, "Je, unadhani mimi ni mbwa asiye na thamani anayeitumikia Yuda? Muda wote huu nimeionyesha fadhili jamaa ya baba yako Sauli, ndugu zake na rafiki zake. Sikumwacha Daudi akukamate. Na sasa unanishtaki kwamba nimekosa kwa ajili ya mwanamke huyu!

vi.L: Áp-ne rất giận về lời của Ích-bô-sết, và nói: "Tôi là đầu chó thuộc về Giu-đa sao? Hôm nay tôi tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với nhà Sau-lơ cha ông, với anh em và bạn hữu người, và tôi đã không để ông rơi vào tay Đa-vít; thế mà hôm nay ông lại buộc tội tôi về người đàn bà này!
vi.B: Áp-ne nổi giận vì lời Ích-bô-sết nói, và bảo: "Tôi là cái đầu chó theo phe Giu-đa sao? Cho đến nay tôi vẫn giữ lòng nhân từ với nhà Sau-lơ cha ông, với anh em và bạn hữu người, và không để ông rơi vào tay Đa-vít. Thế mà bây giờ ông lại bắt tội tôi vì người đàn bà này!
vi.R: Áp-ne rất tức giận vì lời Ích-bô-sết nói. Ông đáp: "Ông nghĩ tôi là một con chó vô dụng làm việc cho Giu-đa sao? Suốt thời gian qua tôi đã đối xử tốt và trung thành với gia đình Sau-lơ cha ông, với họ hàng và bạn bè của người. Tôi đã không để Đa-vít bắt được ông. Thế mà bây giờ ông lại buộc tội tôi đã làm điều sai với người đàn bà này!

ko.L: 그러자 아브넬이 이스보셋의 말 때문에 몹시 화가 나서 말했다. "제가 유다에 [속한] 개 머리[입니까]? 오늘까지 제가 당신의 아버지 사울의 집과 그의 형제들과 그의 친구들에게 한결같은 사랑을 베풀었고, 당신을 다윗의 손에 넘겨주지 않았습니다. 그런데 당신은 오늘 그 여자의 일로 저에게 죄를 씌웁니다.
ko.B: 아브넬은 이스보셋의 말에 몹시 화가 나서 말했다. "제가 유다 편에 붙은 개 대가리라도 된단 말입니까? 저는 지금까지 당신의 아버지 사울의 집안과 그의 형제들과 친구들에게 인애를 지켜 왔고, 당신을 다윗의 손에 넘기지도 않았습니다. 그런데 이제 이 여자의 일로 저를 죄인으로 몰아세우십니까?
ko.R: 아브넬은 이스보셋의 말을 듣고 몹시 화가 났다. 그가 말했다. "제가 유다를 위해 일하는 쓸모없는 개라고 생각하십니까? 저는 지금까지 당신의 아버지 사울의 집안과 그 친척과 친구들에게 인애를 베풀었습니다. 다윗이 당신을 잡아가지 못하게 했습니다. 그런데 이제 이 여자 일로 저를 탓하십니까?

pt.L: E Abner ficou muito irado por causa das palavras de Is-Bosete, e disse: "Sou eu uma cabeça de cão que [pertence] a Judá? Hoje eu mostro lealdade à casa de Saul, o seu pai, aos irmãos dele e aos seus amigos, e não deixei o senhor cair na mão de Davi; e hoje o senhor me acusa de culpa por causa desta mulher!
pt.B: Abner ficou furioso com as palavras de Is-Bosete. "Por acaso eu sou uma cabeça de cão a serviço de Judá?", disse ele. "Até hoje tenho mostrado bondade leal à casa do seu pai Saul, aos irmãos dele e aos seus amigos, e não deixei o senhor cair nas mãos de Davi. E agora o senhor me acusa de ter feito algo errado com essa mulher!
pt.R: Abner ficou muito irritado com o que Is-Bosete disse. Ele respondeu: "O senhor acha que eu sou um cachorro sem valor que trabalha para Judá? Todo esse tempo eu tenho sido bondoso e leal com a família do seu pai Saul, com os parentes e os amigos dele. Eu não deixei Davi capturar o senhor. E agora o senhor me acusa de ter feito algo errado com essa mulher!

decisions.choice: a dog's head: something utterly worthless and despised
alternatives: the leader of a pack of dogs
decisions.reason: The phrase appears only here. Dogs were scavengers, and to call someone a dog was an insult (1 Samuel 17:43; 24:15; 2 Samuel 9:8; 16:9). "A dog's head" seems to sharpen the insult: the most contemptible thing there is. Abner asks whether Ish-bosheth takes him for a worthless traitor, after all he has done for Saul's house. The exact picture is not certain.

decisions.choice: that belongs to Judah
decisions.reason: These words, which make Abner's question "Am I a traitor working for Judah?", are not found in the ancient Greek translation. The Hebrew text has them, and they fit Abner's point: he has fought against Judah, not for it.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyalty owed under a bond
decisions.reason: The word names faithful, committed loyalty, the kind owed within a family or by a covenant. Abner claims that loyalty for himself: he has held Saul's house together.

decisions.choice: I have not let you fall into the hand of David: I have not handed you over to David
decisions.reason: The verb means "cause to be found" in someone's hand, that is, to deliver someone to an enemy's power. Abner reminds Ish-bosheth that his throne depends on Abner.

decisions.choice: you charge me with guilt over the woman: Abner neither denies nor admits the act
decisions.reason: Abner does not say whether he took Rizpah. He treats the charge itself as an insult to his loyalty.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: As set for these books, following Exodus 34:6.

decisions.choice: a dog's head on Judah's side (Balanced); a worthless dog who works for Judah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the unusual picture and makes the relative clause plain; Readable says what the picture means.

decisions.choice: "đầu chó" (L, B); "con chó vô dụng" (R)
decisions.reason: Something utterly worthless (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "개 머리" (Literal), "개 대가리" (Balanced), "쓸모없는 개" (Readable); Abner says "당신" to the king
decisions.reason: Korean, like Hebrew, uses the dog as the picture of something despised; Balanced uses the coarse word for an animal's head to keep the insult, and Readable says what it means. Abner pointedly calls Ish-bosheth neither king nor lord in the Hebrew, so Korean keeps the bare "당신" within the polite style.

decisions.choice: o senhor (Abner to Ish-bosheth)
decisions.reason: Abner answers his king with "o senhor", the address subjects use to a king throughout Samuel in Portuguese. His anger and contempt are in what he says (m1, m4), not in the form of address, as with Goliath's scorn in 1 Samuel 17:43; "você" here would read as plain rudeness rather than the insult of his words. Joab speaks to David the same way in verses 24-25.

decisions.choice: uma cabeça de cão (L, B); um cachorro sem valor (R); lealdade (L), bondade leal (B), bondoso e leal (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the unusual picture (m1), as the English does, with "cão", the word of 1 Samuel 17:43 at Literal; Readable says what it means. The loyalty Abner claims (m3) takes the wording set for ḥesed between people, as in 2:5.

records.literal_gloss: Thus may do God to Abner, and thus may he add to him, for as swore Yahweh to David, so I will do for him,

en.L: Thus may God do to Abner, and thus may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} add to him, for as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has sworn to David, so I will do for him,

en.R: I will now do for David what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised him with an oath. If I do not, may God punish me terribly.

es.L: Así haga Dios a Abner, y así le añada, que como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juró a David, así haré yo por él:

vi.B: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt tôi, là Áp-ne, thật nặng nề nếu tôi không thực hiện cho Đa-vít điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề hứa với người,
vi.R: Bây giờ tôi sẽ làm cho Đa-vít điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề hứa với người. Nếu tôi không làm, nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt tôi nặng nề.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗에게 맹세하신 대로 제가 그에게 그대로 해 주지 않는다면, 하나님께서 아브넬에게 벌을 내리시고 더 내리셔도 좋습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗에게 맹세하신 일을 제가 그를 위해 이루지 않는다면, 하나님께서 이 아브넬에게 무거운 벌을 내리시고 더 내리셔도 좋습니다.
ko.R: 이제 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맹세하며 다윗에게 약속하신 일을 그를 위해 이루겠습니다. 그렇게 하지 않으면 하나님께서 저에게 무서운 벌을 내리셔도 좋습니다.

pt.L: Assim faça Deus a Abner, e assim {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe acrescente, que, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} jurou a Davi, assim eu farei por ele:
pt.B: Que Deus castigue a mim, Abner, com todo o rigor, se eu não fizer por Davi o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe prometeu com juramento:
pt.R: Agora eu vou fazer por Davi o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe prometeu com juramento. Se eu não fizer isso, que Deus me castigue duramente.

decisions.choice: thus may God do to Abner, and thus may he add: a curse on oneself
decisions.reason: This is the form of a solemn oath: the speaker calls down punishment on himself if he fails to keep his word (1 Samuel 3:17; 20:13; verse 35). Abner speaks of himself by name.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh has sworn to David: Abner knows that Yahweh has chosen David
decisions.reason: Yahweh had rejected Saul and chosen David (1 Samuel 15:28; 16:1-13; 25:30). No oath in these exact words is recorded, but Abner speaks of the promise as known. His words show that he has been fighting against what he knew Yahweh had promised.

decisions.choice: for as ... so I will do: the content of the oath
decisions.reason: The sentence runs into verse 10, which says what Abner will do. In an oath like this, the words mean "I will surely do it".

decisions.choice: May God deal with me, Abner, ever so severely
decisions.reason: As in 1 Samuel 20:13, Balanced keeps Abner's name but makes clear that he is the speaker.

decisions.choice: I will now do ... If I do not, may God punish me
decisions.reason: Readable puts the promise first and the curse after it, so that the oath is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: Que Dieu fasse ainsi à Abner, et qu'il y ajoute encore (L); Que Dieu me traite avec sévérité, et plus encore (B); que Dieu me punisse sévèrement (R)
alternatives: Que Dieu me punisse sévèrement at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel: the self-curse oath follows the Samuel terms note at Balanced; Literal keeps the Hebrew form, and Readable says it in plain words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Así haga Dios a Abner, y así le añada" (L); "Que Dios me castigue, y aun más" (B); "que Dios me castigue duramente" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel: Literal follows the Hebrew form of the self-curse word for word, and Balanced takes the wording the Samuel terms note sets; Readable says it plainly, as the English does. The English deity pronoun "he" is only in the Spanish verb ending ("añada"), so it takes no span; "le" here is Abner.

decisions.choice: Mungu amtendee Abneri hivyo, na kuzidi (Literal); Mungu anitendee mimi Abneri hivyo, na kuzidi (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The oath formula is worded as set for Samuel in Swahili; Literal keeps Abner speaking of himself by name, and Balanced adds "mimi" so that the speaker is clear. Readable says plainly that God would punish him. The English "he|He" span falls on a verb prefix in Swahili, so there is none.

decisions.choice: "Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt Áp-ne như vậy, và còn thêm nữa" (L); "Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt tôi ... thật nặng nề" (B, R)
alternatives: "Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời xử với tôi như vậy"
decisions.reason: The self-curse of an oath (meaning decision): the Samuel terms note's formula at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps Abner's third person and "add". Vietnamese has no free pronoun for God here, so the English deity_pronoun on "add" has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: The self-curse "하나님께서 ... 벌을 내리시고 더 내리셔도 좋다", with the condition put first in Korean
alternatives: "하나님이 아브넬에게 이와 같이 하시고 더 하시기를"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for this oath; Korean puts the condition before the curse, so the verse is reordered inside itself and the sentence closes before verse 10.

decisions.choice: Assim faça Deus a Abner, e assim ele lhe acrescente (L); Que Deus castigue a mim, Abner, com todo o rigor (B); que Deus me castigue duramente (R)
decisions.reason: The oath formula (m1) keeps the wording of 1 Samuel 3:17 and 14:44 in Portuguese at each level; Balanced keeps Abner's name, as the English does, with "a mim" so that the reader sees he speaks of himself.

decisions.choice: from Dan to Beersheba: the whole land, from north to south
decisions.reason: Dan was the northernmost town of Israel and Beersheba the southernmost; together they name the whole country (Judges 20:1; 1 Samuel 3:20).

decisions.choice: over Israel and over Judah: two parts named separately
decisions.reason: Since Saul's death, Judah had followed David while the other tribes followed Ish-bosheth (2:9-10). Abner promises to bring both under David.

decisions.choice: throne: royal rule
decisions.reason: To establish someone's throne is to make his rule secure.

decisions.choice: make David king
decisions.reason: Readable says what establishing David's throne means.

decisions.choice: in the far north ... in the far south
decisions.reason: Readable explains where the two towns lie, so that the phrase is understood as the whole land.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아브넬을 두려워했기 때문에, 다시 아브넬에게 한마디도 대답할 수 없었다.
ko.B: 이스보셋은 아브넬이 두려워서 그에게 한마디도 대꾸하지 못했다.
ko.R: 이스보셋은 아브넬이 너무 무서워서 아무 말도 하지 못했다.

pt.L: E ele não pôde responder mais uma palavra a Abner, porque o temia.
pt.B: Is-Bosete não conseguiu dizer mais nenhuma palavra em resposta a Abner, porque tinha medo dele.
pt.R: Is-Bosete tinha tanto medo de Abner que não conseguiu responder nada.

decisions.choice: to return a word: to answer
decisions.reason: "Bring back a word" is a common way of saying "reply" (1 Kings 12:6).

decisions.choice: he could not ... he feared him: Ish-bosheth feared Abner
decisions.reason: The subject is Ish-bosheth, and "him" is Abner. The king of Israel cannot answer his own commander: the real power lies with Abner.

decisions.choice: Ish-bosheth
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the king, so it is clear who feared whom.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אַבְנֵ֨ר מַלְאָכִ֧ים׀אֶל־דָּוִ֛ד תַּחְתָּ֥יו לֵאמֹ֖ר לְמִי־אָ֑רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר כָּרְתָ֤ה בְרִֽיתְךָ֙ אִתִּ֔י וְהִנֵּה֙ יָדִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ לְהָסֵ֥ב אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Abner messengers to David on his behalf, saying, To whom [is the] land? Saying, Make your covenant with me, and here, my hand [will be] with you to bring around to you all Israel.

en.L: And Abner sent messengers to David on his own behalf, saying, "To whom [does the] land [belong]?" saying, "Make your covenant with me, and look, my hand [will be] with you to bring all Israel around to you."
en.B: Abner sent messengers to David on his own behalf to say, "Whose land is it? Make your covenant with me, and I will give you my support to bring all Israel over to you."
en.R: Abner sent messengers to David to speak for him. They said, "Who should rule this land? Make a covenant with me, and I will help you. I will bring all Israel over to your side."

es.L: Y envió Abner mensajeros a David de su parte, diciendo: «¿De quién [es la] tierra?», diciendo: «Haz tu pacto conmigo, y he aquí que mi mano [estará] contigo para traer a ti a todo Israel».
es.B: Abner envió mensajeros a David de su parte para decirle: «¿De quién es esta tierra? Haz tu pacto conmigo, y yo te daré mi apoyo para que todo Israel se pase a tu lado».
es.R: Abner envió mensajeros a David para que hablaran por él. Le dijeron: «¿Quién debe gobernar esta tierra? Haz un pacto conmigo, y yo te ayudaré. Haré que todo Israel se ponga de tu lado».

fr.L: Et Abner envoya de sa part des messagers à David, pour dire : « À qui [est] le pays ? » pour dire : « Conclus ton alliance avec moi, et voici, ma main [sera] avec toi pour ramener vers toi tout Israël. »
fr.B: Abner envoya de sa propre initiative des messagers à David pour lui dire : « À qui appartient le pays ? Conclus ton alliance avec moi, et je t’apporterai mon appui pour rallier à toi tout Israël. »
fr.R: Abner a envoyé des messagers à David pour parler en son nom. Ils ont dit : « Qui doit gouverner ce pays ? Fais une alliance avec moi, et je t’aiderai. Je ferai passer tout Israël de ton côté. »

sw.L: Abneri akatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi kwa niaba yake mwenyewe, akisema, "Nchi [ni] ya nani?" akisema, "Fanya agano lako nami, na tazama, mkono wangu [utakuwa] pamoja nawe kumletea Israeli wote."
sw.B: Abneri alituma wajumbe kwa Daudi kwa niaba yake mwenyewe kumwambia, "Nchi hii ni ya nani? Fanya agano lako nami, nami nitakuunga mkono kuwaleta Israeli wote kwako."
sw.R: Abneri alituma wajumbe kwa Daudi wamsemee. Wakamwambia, "Nani anapaswa kutawala nchi hii? Fanya agano nami, nami nitakusaidia. Nitawaleta Israeli wote upande wako."

vi.L: Áp-ne sai sứ giả thay mặt mình đến cùng Đa-vít mà nói: "Xứ thuộc về ai?" Lại nói: "Hãy lập giao ước của ngài với tôi, và này, tay tôi sẽ ở với ngài để đem toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên về với ngài."
vi.B: Áp-ne sai sứ giả thay mặt mình đến nói với Đa-vít: "Xứ này thuộc về ai? Xin ngài lập giao ước với tôi, và tôi sẽ hết lòng giúp ngài đem toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên về với ngài."
vi.R: Áp-ne sai sứ giả đến nói với Đa-vít thay cho mình: "Ai sẽ cai trị xứ này? Xin ngài lập giao ước với tôi, rồi tôi sẽ giúp ngài. Tôi sẽ đem cả Y-sơ-ra-ên về phe ngài."

ko.L: 그리고 아브넬이 자기를 대신하여 다윗에게 사자들을 보내 말했다. "땅이 누구의 것[입니까]?" 또 말했다. "저와 언약을 맺으십시오. 그러면 보십시오, 제 손이 당신과 함께하여 온 이스라엘을 당신에게로 돌아서게 하겠습니다."
ko.B: 아브넬은 자기 쪽에서 다윗에게 사람들을 보내 이렇게 전했다. "이 땅이 누구의 것입니까? 저와 언약을 맺으십시오. 그러면 제가 힘을 다해 도와서 온 이스라엘을 당신 편으로 돌아서게 하겠습니다."
ko.R: 아브넬은 자기 말을 전할 사람들을 다윗에게 보냈다. 그들이 말했다. "이 땅을 누가 다스려야 하겠습니까? 저와 언약을 맺으십시오. 그러면 제가 도와 드리겠습니다. 온 이스라엘을 당신 편으로 데려오겠습니다."

pt.L: E Abner enviou mensageiros a Davi da sua parte, dizendo: "De quem [é a] terra?", dizendo: "Faça a sua aliança comigo, e eis que a minha mão [estará] com o senhor para fazer voltar todo o Israel para o senhor."
pt.B: Abner enviou mensageiros a Davi, por sua própria conta, para dizer: "De quem é a terra? Faça a sua aliança comigo, e eu darei o meu apoio ao senhor para trazer todo o Israel para o seu lado."
pt.R: Abner enviou mensageiros a Davi para falarem por ele. Eles disseram: "Quem deve governar esta terra? Faça uma aliança comigo, e eu vou ajudar o senhor. Vou trazer todo o Israel para o seu lado."

decisions.choice: on his own behalf
decisions.reason: The word means "in his place" or "under him". It most likely means that Abner acted for himself, not for Ish-bosheth. It could also mean "on the spot" or "from where he was"; the ancient Greek translation has "to Hebron, where he was". The consonants written in the text and the reading in the margin also differ slightly here.

decisions.choice: to whom does the land belong?: a question that points to David
decisions.reason: The question is short and its point is not spelled out. It most likely means that the land is David's by right, as Yahweh has promised (verses 9, 18). It could also hint that Abner is the one who holds the land and can hand it over.

decisions.choice: covenant: a binding agreement
decisions.reason: A covenant was a formal, sworn agreement between two parties (1 Samuel 18:3; 23:18). Abner asks David to bind himself to him.

decisions.choice: my hand will be with you: I will support you
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power and help. Abner offers to use his influence for David.

decisions.choice: I will give you my support (Balanced); I will help you (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "my hand with you" means.

decisions.choice: Who should rule this land?
decisions.reason: Readable makes the point of the question plain: whose right it is to rule.

decisions.choice: l'alliance; conclure une alliance (L, B), faire une alliance (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for covenants between people: the same word as God's covenant, so that the bond keeps its weight.

decisions.choice: Abner calls David "ngài" and himself "tôi" in his message
decisions.reason: Abner treats with David as a ruler before he has submitted to him; from verse 21, when he calls him "my lord the king", he takes the subjects' forms.

decisions.choice: o senhor (Abner to David)
decisions.reason: Abner's messengers speak for him to David, now king of Judah, with "o senhor", the address due to a king; when Abner comes in person he calls David "meu senhor, o rei" (verse 21, m1). David answers Abner with "você" (verse 13), as a king to a subject, and Abner and Joab, commanders of equal rank, say "você" to each other (2:20-27).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ט֔וֹב אֲנִ֕י אֶכְרֹ֥ת אִתְּךָ֖ בְּרִ֑ית אַ֣ךְ דָּבָ֣ר אֶחָ֡ד אָנֹכִי֩ שֹׁאֵ֨ל מֵאִתְּךָ֤ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹא־תִרְאֶ֣ה אֶת־פָּנַ֔י כִּ֣י׀אִם־לִפְנֵ֣י הֱבִיאֲךָ֗ אֵ֚ת מִיכַ֣ל בַּת־שָׁא֔וּל בְּבֹאֲךָ֖ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־פָּנָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Good; I will make with you a covenant; only one thing I am asking from you, saying, Not you will see my face unless before you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see my face.

en.L: And he said, "Good. I will make a covenant with you. Only one thing I ask of you, namely: you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see my face."
en.B: David replied, "Good. I will make a covenant with you. But I require one thing of you: you will not see my face unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul with you when you come to see me."
en.R: David answered, "Good! I will make a covenant with you. I ask only one thing of you. Do not come to see me unless you bring Saul's daughter Michal with you."

es.L: Y él dijo: «Bien. Yo haré pacto contigo. Solo una cosa te pido, a saber: no verás mi rostro a menos que primero traigas a Mical hija de Saúl cuando vengas a ver mi rostro».
es.B: David respondió: «Bien. Haré un pacto contigo. Pero te exijo una cosa: no verás mi rostro a menos que traigas contigo a Mical hija de Saúl cuando vengas a verme».
es.R: David contestó: «¡Bien! Haré un pacto contigo. Solo te pido una cosa. No vengas a verme si no traes contigo a Mical, la hija de Saúl».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Bien. Moi, je conclurai une alliance avec toi. Seulement, il y a une chose que je te demande, à savoir : tu ne verras pas ma face sans m’avoir d’abord amené Mikal, fille de Saül, quand tu viendras voir ma face. »
fr.B: David répondit : « C’est bien. Je conclurai une alliance avec toi. Mais j’exige de toi une chose : tu ne seras pas reçu en ma présence si tu n’amènes pas avec toi Mikal, fille de Saül, quand tu viendras me voir. »
fr.R: David a répondu : « D’accord ! Je ferai une alliance avec toi. Je te demande seulement une chose. Ne viens pas me voir sans amener avec toi Mikal, la fille de Saül. »

sw.L: Akasema, "Vema. Mimi nitafanya agano nawe. Ila jambo moja ninakuomba, yaani: hutaniona uso wangu usipomleta kwanza Mikali binti Sauli utakapokuja kuuona uso wangu."
sw.B: Daudi akajibu, "Vema. Nitafanya agano nawe. Lakini nakutaka jambo moja: hutaniona uso wangu usipomleta Mikali binti Sauli pamoja nawe utakapokuja kuniona."
sw.R: Daudi akajibu, "Vizuri! Nitafanya agano nawe. Nakuomba jambo moja tu. Usije kuniona usipomleta Mikali binti Sauli pamoja nawe."

vi.L: [Đa-vít] nói: "Tốt. Ta sẽ lập giao ước với ông. Chỉ có một điều ta đòi ông, ấy là: ông sẽ không thấy mặt ta, trừ khi ông đem Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ đến trước, khi ông đến thấy mặt ta."
vi.B: Đa-vít đáp: "Tốt. Ta sẽ lập giao ước với ông. Nhưng ta đòi ông một điều: ông sẽ không được gặp mặt ta nếu không đem Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ theo khi đến gặp ta."
vi.R: Đa-vít trả lời: "Được! Ta sẽ lập giao ước với ông. Ta chỉ đòi ông một điều. Đừng đến gặp ta nếu ông không đưa Mi-canh, con gái Sau-lơ, đến cùng."

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "좋다. 내가 너와 언약을 맺겠다. 다만 한 가지를 내가 너에게 요구한다. 네가 내 얼굴을 보러 올 때에 먼저 사울의 딸 미갈을 데려오지 않으면, 너는 내 얼굴을 보지 못할 것이다."
ko.B: 다윗이 대답했다. "좋다. 내가 너와 언약을 맺겠다. 그러나 너에게 한 가지 요구할 것이 있다. 나를 만나러 올 때 사울의 딸 미갈을 데려오지 않으면 너는 내 얼굴을 볼 수 없을 것이다."
ko.R: 다윗이 대답했다. "좋다! 너와 언약을 맺겠다. 다만 한 가지만 부탁한다. 사울의 딸 미갈을 데려오지 않으려면 나를 보러 오지 마라."

pt.L: E ele disse: "Bem. Eu farei uma aliança com você. Somente uma coisa eu lhe peço, a saber: você não verá o meu rosto, a não ser que antes traga Mical, filha de Saul, quando vier ver o meu rosto."
pt.B: Davi respondeu: "Está bem. Farei uma aliança com você. Mas exijo de você uma coisa: você não verá o meu rosto se não trouxer Mical, filha de Saul, quando vier me ver."
pt.R: Davi respondeu: "Ótimo! Farei uma aliança com você. Só lhe peço uma coisa. Não venha me ver se não trouxer Mical, a filha de Saul, com você."

decisions.choice: he said: David answers
decisions.reason: The subject is David, to whom Abner's messengers came (verse 12).

decisions.choice: see my face: come into my presence
decisions.reason: To see a ruler's face is to be received by him (Genesis 43:3, 5; 2 Samuel 14:24). David will not meet Abner without Michal.

decisions.choice: Michal daughter of Saul: David's first wife
decisions.reason: Saul gave Michal to David as his wife (1 Samuel 18:27), but after David fled, Saul gave her to another man (1 Samuel 25:44). Having Saul's daughter back as his wife would also strengthen David's claim, as Saul's son-in-law, to rule over Saul's kingdom.

decisions.choice: unless you first bring: Michal must come before the meeting
decisions.reason: The words mean "unless before that you bring", so Michal's return is the condition for Abner's visit.

decisions.choice: David
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: Do not come to see me unless you bring ... with you
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two mentions of "see my face" into one plain sentence.

decisions.choice: David says "ta" and "ông" to Abner
decisions.reason: The king speaks to a powerful commander he is negotiating with: "ta" for the king, but "ông" rather than "ngươi" for an older man of rank.

decisions.choice: David speaks to Abner in the plain style (해라체); Abner speaks to David in the formal polite style (합쇼체), calling him "당신" until he names him "내 주 임금님" (verse 21)
alternatives: David answering in the polite style
decisions.reason: David is already a king and Abner comes to him offering to serve; the Samuel terms note has a king speak 해라체 to subjects.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־אִֽישׁ־בֹּ֥שֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁא֖וּל לֵאמֹ֑ר תְּנָ֤ה אֶת־אִשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־מִיכַ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵרַ֣שְׂתִּי לִ֔י בְּמֵאָ֖ה עָרְל֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent David messengers to Ish-bosheth son of Saul, saying, Give my wife, Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred foreskins of Philistines.

en.L: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth son of Saul, saying, "Give [me] my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred foreskins of [the] Philistines."
en.B: Then David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth son of Saul to say, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I won as my bride at the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."
en.R: Then David sent messengers to Saul's son Ish-bosheth. He told them to say, "Give me back my wife Michal. I paid for her with the foreskins of one hundred Philistines."

es.L: Y envió David mensajeros a Isboset hijo de Saúl, diciendo: «Da[me] a mi mujer Mical, que desposé para mí por cien prepucios de filisteos».
es.B: Luego David envió mensajeros a Isboset hijo de Saúl para decirle: «Dame a mi esposa Mical, a quien gané como esposa al precio de cien prepucios de filisteos».
es.R: Después David envió mensajeros a Isboset, hijo de Saúl. Les dijo que dijeran: «Devuélveme a mi esposa Mical. Pagué por ella con los prepucios de cien filisteos».

fr.L: Et David envoya des messagers à Ishbosheth fils de Saül, pour dire : « Donne[-moi] ma femme Mikal, que je me suis fiancée pour cent prépuces de Philistins. »
fr.B: Puis David envoya des messagers à Ishbosheth, fils de Saül, pour lui dire : « Rends-moi ma femme Mikal, que j’ai obtenue comme fiancée au prix de cent prépuces de Philistins. »
fr.R: Ensuite David a envoyé des messagers à Ishbosheth, le fils de Saül. Il leur a dit de déclarer : « Rends-moi ma femme Mikal. J’ai payé pour elle avec les prépuces de cent Philistins. »

sw.L: Daudi akatuma wajumbe kwa Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli, akisema, "Nipe mke wangu Mikali, niliyejiposea kwa govi mia moja za Wafilisti."
sw.B: Kisha Daudi alituma wajumbe kwa Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli kumwambia, "Nipe mke wangu Mikali, niliyemposa kwa mahari ya govi mia moja za Wafilisti."
sw.R: Kisha Daudi akatuma wajumbe kwa Ishboshethi mwana wa Sauli. Akawaagiza waseme, "Nirudishie mke wangu Mikali. Nilimlipia mahari ya govi za Wafilisti mia moja."

vi.L: Đa-vít sai sứ giả đến cùng Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ mà nói: "Hãy trả [lại] cho ta vợ ta là Mi-canh, người mà ta đã cưới làm vợ bằng một trăm dương bì của người Phi-li-tin."
vi.B: Rồi Đa-vít sai sứ giả đến nói với Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ: "Hãy trả lại cho ta vợ ta là Mi-canh, người ta đã đính hôn bằng sính lễ là một trăm dương bì của người Phi-li-tin."
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít sai sứ giả đến gặp Ích-bô-sết con trai Sau-lơ. Ông bảo họ nói: "Hãy trả lại cho ta Mi-canh vợ ta. Ta đã trả sính lễ cưới nàng bằng dương bì của một trăm người Phi-li-tin."

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 사울의 아들 이스보셋에게 사자들을 보내 말했다. "내가 블레셋 사람들의 포피 백 개로 나에게 약혼시킨 내 아내 미갈을 [나에게] 돌려주어라."
ko.B: 그리고 다윗은 사울의 아들 이스보셋에게 사람들을 보내 이렇게 전했다. "내가 블레셋 사람의 포피 백 개를 바치고 얻은 내 아내 미갈을 내게 돌려보내라."
ko.R: 그리고 다윗은 사울의 아들 이스보셋에게 사람들을 보내 이렇게 말하게 했다. "내 아내 미갈을 돌려보내라. 나는 블레셋 사람 백 명의 포피를 바치고 미갈과 결혼했다."

pt.L: E Davi enviou mensageiros a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, dizendo: "Entregue[-me] a minha mulher Mical, que eu desposei para mim por cem prepúcios de filisteus."
pt.B: Então Davi enviou mensageiros a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, para dizer: "Entregue-me a minha mulher Mical, que conquistei como noiva pelo preço de cem prepúcios de filisteus."
pt.R: Então Davi enviou mensageiros a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul. Mandou que dissessem: "Devolva-me a minha mulher Mical. Eu paguei por ela com os prepúcios de cem filisteus."

decisions.choice: David sends to Ish-bosheth: an open, lawful demand
decisions.reason: David does not ask Abner to steal Michal away. He demands her from the king of Saul's house as his lawful wife, and Ish-bosheth gives way (verse 15).

decisions.choice: betrothed to myself: made a binding agreement of marriage
decisions.reason: Betrothal was the agreement, with the bride-price paid, that made a woman a man's wife in law even before they lived together (Deuteronomy 20:7; 22:23-24). David's claim to Michal rests on it.

decisions.choice: a hundred foreskins of Philistines: the bride-price Saul set
decisions.reason: Saul asked a hundred Philistine foreskins as the bride-price (1 Samuel 18:25). David had brought two hundred (1 Samuel 18:27); here he names the price agreed.

decisions.choice: foreskins
decisions.reason: As in 1 Samuel 18:25, the word is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: whom I won as my bride at the price of
decisions.reason: Balanced uses wording that shows both the engagement and the price paid.

decisions.choice: niliyemposa kwa mahari ya (Balanced); nilimlipia mahari ya (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Mahari" (bride-price) is the familiar Swahili word for what the groom paid, so Balanced and Readable use it to show both the betrothal and the price; "govi" (foreskin) is kept at every level, as the English keeps it.

decisions.choice: "dương bì"
decisions.reason: The usual Vietnamese Bible word for a foreskin; the bride-price (meaning decision) is named "sính lễ" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: desposei (L); conquistei como noiva (B); paguei por ela (R); cem prepúcios de filisteus
decisions.reason: "Desposar" is the Portuguese verb for taking a woman as one's wife by agreement (m2), which Balanced turns into the bride won at a price, as the English does. "Prepúcios" is kept at every level, as in 1 Samuel 18:25 in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אִ֣ישׁ בֹּ֔שֶׁת וַיִּקָּחֶ֖הָ מֵ֣עִֽם אִ֑ישׁ מֵעִ֖ם פַּלְטִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־לָֽיִשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Ish-bosheth and took her from with [a] husband, from with Paltiel son of Laish.

en.L: And Ish-bosheth sent and took her from [her] husband, from Paltiel son of Laish.
en.B: So Ish-bosheth sent and took her away from her husband, Paltiel son of Laish.
en.R: So Ish-bosheth sent men to take her away from her husband, Paltiel son of Laish.

es.L: Y envió Isboset y la tomó de [su] marido, de Paltiel hijo de Lais.
es.B: Entonces Isboset mandó a quitársela a su marido, Paltiel hijo de Lais.
es.R: Entonces Isboset envió a unos hombres a quitársela a su esposo, Paltiel, hijo de Lais.

fr.L: Et Ishbosheth envoya et la prit d’auprès [de son] mari, d’auprès de Paltiel fils de Laïsh.
fr.B: Ishbosheth envoya donc la reprendre à son mari, Paltiel fils de Laïsh.
fr.R: Alors Ishbosheth a envoyé des hommes la reprendre à son mari, Paltiel, le fils de Laïsh.

sw.L: Ishboshethi akatuma akamchukua kutoka kwa mume [wake], kutoka kwa Paltieli mwana wa Laishi.
sw.B: Basi Ishboshethi alituma watu wakamchukua kutoka kwa mumewe, Paltieli mwana wa Laishi.
sw.R: Basi Ishboshethi akatuma watu wakamchukue kutoka kwa mumewe, Paltieli mwana wa Laishi.

vi.L: Ích-bô-sết sai người bắt nàng khỏi chồng, khỏi Pha-ti-ên con trai La-ít.
vi.B: Vậy Ích-bô-sết sai người đến đem nàng đi khỏi chồng nàng là Pha-ti-ên con trai La-ít.
vi.R: Vậy Ích-bô-sết sai người đến đưa nàng đi khỏi chồng nàng là Pha-ti-ên con trai La-ít.

ko.L: 그러자 이스보셋이 [사람을] 보내 그 여자를 [그의] 남편, 라이스의 아들 발디엘에게서 데려왔다.
ko.B: 그러자 이스보셋은 사람을 보내 그 여자를 그의 남편 라이스의 아들 발디엘에게서 데려왔다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스보셋은 사람들을 보내 미갈을 그의 남편, 라이스의 아들 발디엘에게서 데려오게 했다.

pt.L: E Is-Bosete mandou tirá-la do [seu] marido, de Paltiel, filho de Laís.
pt.B: Então Is-Bosete mandou buscá-la e a tirou do seu marido, Paltiel, filho de Laís.
pt.R: Então Is-Bosete mandou homens para tirá-la do marido dela, Paltiel, filho de Laís.

decisions.choice: Paltiel: the man Saul gave Michal to
decisions.reason: He is called Palti in 1 Samuel 25:44, a shorter form of the same name.

decisions.choice: Laish: the reading noted in the margin
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text spell the father's name differently; the scribes' marginal reading gives Laish, as in 1 Samuel 25:44.

decisions.choice: sent and took her: had her taken
decisions.reason: Ish-bosheth acts through others. He does as David demands, which shows how weak his position has become.

decisions.choice: sent men
decisions.reason: Readable says who carried out the order.

source.text: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ אִתָּ֜הּ אִישָׁ֗הּ הָל֧וֹךְ וּבָכֹ֛ה אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ עַד־בַּֽחֻרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֥יו אַבְנֵ֛ר לֵ֥ךְ שׁ֖וּב וַיָּשֹֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: And went with her her husband, going and weeping after her, to Bahurim; and said to him Abner, Go, return; and he returned.

en.L: And her husband went with her, going and weeping behind her, as far as Bahurim. And Abner said to him, "Go, return." And he returned.
en.B: Her husband went with her, weeping as he followed behind her as far as Bahurim. There Abner told him, "Go on, go back." And he went back.
en.R: Her husband went along with her. He cried as he walked behind her all the way to the town of Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go home!" So he went home.

es.L: Y su marido fue con ella, yendo y llorando tras ella, hasta Bahurim. Y le dijo Abner: «Anda, vuélvete». Y se volvió.
es.B: Su marido se fue con ella, llorando mientras la seguía, hasta Bahurim. Allí Abner le dijo: «Anda, vuélvete». Y él se volvió.
es.R: Su esposo la acompañó. Fue llorando detrás de ella todo el camino hasta el pueblo de Bahurim. Entonces Abner le dijo: «¡Vete a tu casa!». Y él se fue a su casa.

fr.L: Et son mari alla avec elle, marchant et pleurant derrière elle, jusqu’à Bahourim. Et Abner lui dit : « Va, retourne. » Et il retourna.
fr.B: Son mari partit avec elle et la suivit en pleurant jusqu’à Bahourim. Là, Abner lui dit : « Va, rentre chez toi. » Et il s’en retourna.
fr.R: Son mari est parti avec elle. Il a marché derrière elle en pleurant jusqu’à la ville de Bahourim. Alors Abner lui a dit : « Rentre chez toi ! » Et il est rentré chez lui.

sw.L: Mumewe akaenda pamoja naye, akienda huku akilia nyuma yake, mpaka Bahurimu. Abneri akamwambia, "Nenda, rudi." Naye akarudi.
sw.B: Mumewe alikwenda pamoja naye, akilia huku akimfuata nyuma mpaka Bahurimu. Huko Abneri akamwambia, "Nenda, rudi nyumbani." Naye akarudi.
sw.R: Mumewe alikwenda pamoja naye. Alilia huku akitembea nyuma yake njia yote mpaka mji wa Bahurimu. Ndipo Abneri akamwambia, "Rudi nyumbani!" Basi akarudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Chồng nàng đi theo nàng, vừa đi vừa khóc theo sau nàng cho đến Ba-hu-rim. Áp-ne bảo người: "Hãy đi về đi." Người liền trở về.
vi.B: Chồng nàng đi theo, vừa đi vừa khóc theo sau nàng cho đến Ba-hu-rim. Tại đó Áp-ne bảo người: "Thôi, hãy trở về đi." Người trở về.
vi.R: Chồng nàng cũng đi theo. Ông vừa đi theo sau nàng vừa khóc suốt đường cho đến làng Ba-hu-rim. Rồi Áp-ne bảo ông: "Về nhà đi!" Vậy ông trở về nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자의 남편이 그 여자와 함께 가며, 울면서 그 여자를 뒤따라 바후림까지 갔다. 그리고 아브넬이 그에게 말했다. "가라, 돌아가라." 그러자 그가 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 그 여자의 남편은 울면서 그 뒤를 따라 바후림까지 왔다. 거기에서 아브넬이 그에게 "이제 돌아가라" 하고 말하자 그가 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 미갈의 남편도 함께 따라왔다. 그는 미갈 뒤를 따라 바후림 마을까지 울면서 걸어왔다. 그때 아브넬이 그에게 "집으로 돌아가라!" 하고 말했다. 그래서 그는 집으로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E o seu marido foi com ela, andando e chorando atrás dela, até Baurim. E Abner lhe disse: "Vá, volte." E ele voltou.
pt.B: O marido dela foi junto, chorando enquanto a seguia, até Baurim. Ali Abner lhe disse: "Vá embora, volte." E ele voltou.
pt.R: O marido dela foi junto com ela. Ele foi chorando atrás dela até a cidade de Baurim. Então Abner lhe disse: "Volte para casa!" E ele voltou para casa.

decisions.choice: going and weeping: he wept all the way
decisions.reason: The two verbs describe a continuing action. The short sentence lets the reader see what the bargain cost Paltiel.

decisions.choice: Bahurim: a village east of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Bahurim lay on the road from Jerusalem down to the Jordan valley (16:5; 17:18), in Benjamin near the edge of Judah. Paltiel follows Michal to the border of David's territory.

decisions.choice: Abner gives the order
decisions.reason: Abner, not the king, sends Paltiel back. He is in charge of handing Michal over (verse 12).

decisions.choice: the town of Bahurim
decisions.reason: As set for these books, Readable adds "the town of" before a bare place name that could confuse.

decisions.choice: Paltiel, filho de Laís (verse 15); Baurim
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the names take their usual Brazilian forms; "Laís" with the accent Portuguese needs for its stress, as the town of Judges 18:7 in Portuguese, and "Baurim" without the "h" (m2), as "Ainoã" and "Aimaás" drop it.

source.text: וּדְבַר־אַבְנֵ֣ר הָיָ֔ה עִם־זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר גַּם־תְּמוֹל֙ גַּם־שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם הֱיִיתֶ֞ם מְבַקְשִׁ֧ים אֶת־דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] word of Abner was with [the] elders of Israel, saying, Both yesterday and the third day you were seeking David as king over you.

en.L: And the word of Abner was with the elders of Israel, saying, "Both yesterday and the day before you have been seeking David [to be] king over you.
en.B: Abner had talks with the elders of Israel. He said, "For some time now you have wanted David as your king.
en.R: Abner talked with the leaders of Israel. He said, "For a long time now you have wanted David to be your king.

es.L: Y la palabra de Abner fue con los ancianos de Israel, diciendo: «Tanto ayer como anteayer {{plural_you:ustedes buscaban|vosotros buscabais}} a David [como] rey sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Abner habló con los ancianos de Israel. Les dijo: «Desde hace algún tiempo {{plural_you:ustedes quieren|vosotros queréis}} que David sea {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} rey.
es.R: Abner habló con los líderes de Israel. Les dijo: «Hace ya mucho tiempo que {{plural_you:ustedes quieren|vosotros queréis}} que David sea {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} rey.

fr.L: Et la parole d’Abner fut avec les anciens d’Israël, disant : « Hier comme avant-hier, vous cherchiez David [pour qu’il soit] roi sur vous.
fr.B: Abner eut des entretiens avec les anciens d’Israël. Il leur dit : « Depuis longtemps déjà, vous souhaitez avoir David pour roi.
fr.R: Abner a parlé avec les chefs d’Israël. Il leur a dit : « Depuis longtemps, vous voulez que David soit votre roi.

sw.L: Neno la Abneri likawa pamoja na wazee wa Israeli, akisema, "Jana na juzi mlikuwa mkimtafuta Daudi [awe] mfalme juu yenu.
sw.B: Abneri alizungumza na wazee wa Israeli. Akasema, "Kwa muda sasa mmekuwa mkimtaka Daudi awe mfalme wenu.
sw.R: Abneri alizungumza na viongozi wa Israeli. Akasema, "Kwa muda mrefu sasa mmetaka Daudi awe mfalme wenu.

vi.L: Lời của Áp-ne ở cùng các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên rằng: "Cả hôm qua lẫn hôm trước, các ông đã tìm Đa-vít [để lập] làm vua trên các ông.
vi.B: Áp-ne bàn bạc với các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông nói: "Từ lâu nay các ông vẫn muốn có Đa-vít làm vua mình.
vi.R: Áp-ne nói chuyện với các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông nói: "Đã lâu nay các ông muốn Đa-vít làm vua mình.

ko.L: 그리고 아브넬의 말이 이스라엘 장로들과 함께 있었는데, [그가] 말했다. "여러분은 어제도 그제도 다윗을 여러분의 왕으로 [세우기를] 바라고 있었습니다.
ko.B: 아브넬은 이스라엘의 장로들과 의논하며 말했다. "여러분은 오래전부터 다윗을 여러분의 왕으로 모시기를 바라 왔습니다.
ko.R: 아브넬은 이스라엘의 지도자들과 이야기를 나누었다. 그가 말했다. "여러분은 오래전부터 다윗이 여러분의 왕이 되기를 바랐습니다.

pt.L: E a palavra de Abner esteve com os anciãos de Israel, dizendo: "Tanto ontem como anteontem vocês procuravam Davi [para ser] rei sobre vocês.
pt.B: Abner teve conversas com os anciãos de Israel. Ele disse: "Já faz tempo que vocês querem Davi como rei.
pt.R: Abner conversou com os líderes de Israel. Ele disse: "Já faz muito tempo que vocês querem que Davi seja o rei de vocês.

decisions.choice: yesterday and the third day: for some time past
decisions.reason: "Yesterday and the day before" is a common way of saying "before now, for some time" (Exodus 5:8; 1 Samuel 19:7).

decisions.choice: the elders of Israel: the leaders of the tribes
decisions.reason: The elders were the heads of families and clans who spoke for the people. Here "Israel" means the tribes that had followed Ish-bosheth (2:9).

decisions.choice: the word of Abner was with: Abner held talks
decisions.reason: The phrase means that Abner spoke with them and won them over, not that he gave one short message.

decisions.choice: leaders
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaders" for "elders", since the point is their place in the people, not their age.

decisions.choice: Abner speaks to the elders of Israel in the formal polite style with "여러분"
decisions.reason: He is persuading the tribal leaders, not commanding them.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֤ר אֶל־דָּוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּיַ֣ד׀דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֗י הוֹשִׁ֜יעַ אֶת־עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִיַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּמִיַּ֖ד כָּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now act, for Yahweh has said to David, saying, By [the] hand of David my servant save my people Israel from [the] hand of [the] Philistines and from [the] hand of all their enemies.

en.L: And now act! For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken concerning David, saying, 'By the hand of David {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave I will save {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.'"
en.B: Now do it! For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said of David, 'Through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David I will rescue {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel from the power of the Philistines and of all their enemies.'"
en.R: Now is the time to act! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has said about David, 'I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David to rescue {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel from the Philistines and from all their enemies.'"

es.L: Y ahora, ¡{{plural_you:actúen|actuad}}! Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado de David, diciendo: “Por mano de David {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo salvaré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel de mano de los filisteos y de mano de todos sus enemigos”».
es.B: ¡Ahora {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}}! Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho de David: “Por medio de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David libraré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel del poder de los filisteos y de todos sus enemigos”».
es.R: ¡Ahora es el momento de actuar! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho de David: “Usaré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David para rescatar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel de los filisteos y de todos sus enemigos”».

fr.L: Et maintenant, agissez ! Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé de David, en disant : “Par la main de David, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, je sauverai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël de la main des Philistins et de la main de tous ses ennemis.” »
fr.B: Maintenant, passez à l’action ! Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit de David : “C’est par David, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, que je délivrerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël du pouvoir des Philistins et de tous ses ennemis.” »
fr.R: C’est le moment d’agir ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit au sujet de David : “Je me servirai de David, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, pour délivrer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël des Philistins et de tous ses ennemis.” »

sw.L: Basi sasa fanyeni! Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kuhusu Daudi, akisema, 'Kwa mkono wa Daudi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} nitawaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kutoka mkononi mwa Wafilisti na kutoka mkononi mwa adui zao wote.'"
sw.B: Sasa fanyeni hivyo! Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kuhusu Daudi, 'Kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi nitawaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kutoka katika nguvu za Wafilisti na za adui zao wote.'"
sw.R: Sasa ni wakati wa kutenda! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kuhusu Daudi, 'Nitamtumia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kutoka kwa Wafilisti na kutoka kwa adui zao wote.'"

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ hãy hành động! Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán về Đa-vít rằng: 'Bởi tay Đa-vít, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi tay người Phi-li-tin và khỏi tay mọi kẻ thù của họ.'"
